Dear Timefold team,

I'm writing to apply for the medior UX Designer role. Your mission to free the world from wasteful scheduling resonates with me—I enjoy turning complex, technical problems into clear, usable experiences.

My background combines web development, SEO, and digital marketing. At ViviDoctor I built front-end features for a healthcare web application, and at Knowledge Experts I designed and built WordPress sites for clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. As a freelancer, I designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com from scratch, focusing on accessible markup, structured data, and clean interfaces. I also have hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, which helps me collaborate closely with engineers.

While my recent work has been more marketing-focused, I bring a strong eye for visual detail, a pragmatic approach, and a genuine curiosity about UX. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Timefold's product team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Timefold team,

I'm excited to apply for the medior UX Designer position at Timefold. Your mission to free the world from wasteful scheduling and your open-core approach to optimization resonate with me—I enjoy working on products that solve complex, real-world problems.

My background sits at the intersection of web development, design, and digital marketing. At ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, which gave me a solid understanding of how design decisions translate into code. Later, at Knowledge Experts, I designed and built WordPress websites for clients including ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, handling everything from site structure to content and social media integration. As a freelancer, I designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com from the ground up, focusing on accessible markup, structured data, and a clean, modular layout. I also created a consistent layout system for ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association site.

While my recent roles have been more marketing-focused, I bring a strong eye for visual detail, a pragmatic approach to shipping and iterating, and hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that helps me collaborate effectively with engineers. I'm comfortable working with design systems and component libraries, and I'm eager to deepen my UX skills in a product-driven environment.

I'm curious, motivated to make an impact, and comfortable taking ownership. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my mix of technical and design experience can contribute to Timefold's product team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
